title: How To Tame All Animals In Hytale
description: When Hytale was released, you could find and interact with a slew of different mobs. From enemies with weapons to peaceful animals wandering a meadow, these mobs are all over the map, regardless of your world seed. However, if you tried to tame one of the many animals in Hytale, as you can do in Minecraft, you were met with some disappointment, as that feature wasn't live when the game launched. Fortunately, the developers at Hypixel have been releasing constant updates since release, and a new update has added the ability to tame animals in Hytale. Below, you can see how the taming process works and the items needed to tame all possible animals you can find throughout the world. How taming animals works in Hytale As you might have expected, taming animals in Hytale is extremely similar to the way it works in Minecraft. However, the developers have stressed that the current version of taming is basic and in the early stages of development, so it could change down the line as Hytale progresses through early access. Ubisoft Just Ceased Game Development At The Studio That Created Rainbow Six - Report
description: Ubisoft subsidiary Red Storm Entertainment has just laid off over 100 developers and is ceasing game development, according to new reports. Both VGC and GamesIndustry.biz reported on the layoffs at the North Carolina game studio on Thursday morning. There were 105 jobs cut as part of Ubisoft's latest round of layoffs, and Red Storm Entertainment will now be a support studio working on the Snowdrop game engine, IT services, and customer relations rather than active game development. It's a sad end for a studio that played a major role in making Ubisoft what it is today. Red Storm Entertainment, co-founded by Tom Clancy himself, created the Rainbow Six series in 1998 and was acquired by Ubisoft in 2000. Over the next two decades, it would help build up the Ghost Recon series and The Division in addition to spearheading Ubisoft's VR development with Werewolves Within and Star Trek: Bridge Crew. title: CoD: Warzone's Black Ops Royale Gets A Highly Requested New Playlist
description: Black Ops Royale launched last week for Call of Duty: Warzone, but the developer Raven Software is already adding one of the most-requested features to the new mode. A solo playlist is arriving later today, but the developer did warn the gameplay currently isn't tuned for the single-player experience. Season 2 Reloaded added Black Ops Royale as a brand-new battle royale mode, which is heavily inspired by Call of Duty's original Blackout battle royale that was introduced in 2018. Black Ops Royale mode launched with only the option to play in squads of four, but many players wanted a solo queue to tackle the fight alone. Raven Software announced the solo playlist will arrive on March 19 at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET as both a public playlist and a private match option. However, the developer also warned the mode was "originally designed and balanced to launch as a quads experience," and adjustments might be needed for the solo playlist. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: This Week's Epic Games Store Freebie Is Electrifying
description: The Epic Games Store continues to give away a free game each week, and this week's offering is another nice find at a price that can't be beat. title: Crimson Desert Dev's Stock Plunges Following The Game's Reviews
description: Crimson Desert is out today after over half a decade in development, and the early reviews aren't especially stellar. That may be why the stock price of the game's developer, Pearl Abyss, has dropped nearly 30% since the Crimson Desert reviews were released. According to Seoul Economic Daily, Pearl Abyss is currently trading at 46,600 won--approximately $31.11 in USD--which is down 28.96% from the 65,600 won/$43.79 price that it had earlier in the week. The game's performance may be concerning investors because it reportedly cost 200,000,000 won/$133.5 million to develop. GameSpot's Crimson Desert review gave it 7/10 and praised its open-world environment, combat, and traversal, while criticizing the quest design, the way the narrative unfolds, and the game's inventory system. On our sister-site Metacritic, Crimson Desert currently has a 78 score, which is far from catastrophic. But the Seoul Economic Daily notes that the stock market "expected a score in the mid-to-high 80s." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Life Is Strange TV Show Adds A Veteran Emmy-Nominated Director
description: Prime Video's Life is Strange TV series is progressing ahead with the announcement of who will direct the first two episodes. According to Variety, Karyn Kusama has signed on to direct the first and second episodes of the upcoming game adaptation. Kusama is known for directing the movies Girlfight (which she also wrote), along with Æon Flux, Jennifer's Body, The Invitation, and Destroyer. Perhaps more relevant to Life Is Strange, she also directed episodes of popular TV shows, including The L Word, Halt and Catch Fire, The Man in the High Castle, Masters of Sex, Billions, and Yellowjackets. title: Fortnite Is Adding These Iconic Game Of Thrones Characters Soon, It Seems
description: Fortnite's next big crossover is with Game of Thrones, it seems. A report from the Epic-partnered "leak" account ShiinaBR states that the popular characters Daenerys Targaryen, Jon Snow, and The Night King are all coming to Fortnite on March 20 as part of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2. This is the first time that Game of Thrones characters are coming to Fortnite. Numerous other characters and franchises owned by Warner Bros. have been added to Fortnite before, including Mortal Kombat, Harry Potter, and Batman. With Game of Thrones now heading to Fortnite, that leaves at least one big omission from the WB stable: The Lord the Rings. To date, no LOTR characters have appeared in Fortnite, but that could be something to do with the rights being a tad more complicated given that Embracer owns the gaming rights. title: Sony Will Drop All PlayStation Network Branding This Year - Report
description: Sony has reportedly announced plans to retire all PlayStation Network branding by September 2026, according to a leaked email that was sent to developers (via '). "We'd like to inform you that Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) has strategically decided to phase out the terms 'PlayStation Network' and 'PSN' across our platform in order to properly capture the breadth of our evolving digital services," the email reportedly reads. It's not immediately clear what Sony means with regard to properly capturing "the breadth of [its] evolving digital services," but it could be a sign that Sony is trying to move away from being seen as a company that only makes console games, especially given the fact that its next-gen competition is Microsoft's mysterious Xbox PC/console platform, Project Helix. But according to the email, Sony doesn't plan to get rid of PSN itself--it's just getting a new name. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Ex-Overwatch Dev's New FPS Action Game Opens For Testing Soon, How To Sign Up
description: The new game from former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan, The Legend of California, will hold its first public playtest very soon. Developer Kintsugiyama has announced an alpha test for The Legend of California, and it will be held March 26-30 on Steam. This is not an open test available to everyone, however. People can sign up for the test by visiting the main store page and clicking the [Request Access] button. This will be a "very small" test, the developer said, and that means not everyone who signs will get in. Players who are accepted into the test will receive a notification from Steam, and from there, the alpha client will be automatically added to their game library. It will take up about 50GB of space, and an SSD is required. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: The Movie That Inspired Mortal Kombat's Testicular Destruction Is Getting An A24 Remake
description: Get ready for a Kumite, as a remake of Bloodsport is in production. This new spin on the 1988 film that launched Jean-Claude Van Damme's career as an action star will be written and directed by I May Destroy You creator Michaela Coel for A24 Films. This will be the third time that Coel has collaborated with the famed film company, following her work on the mini-series First Day on Earth and Mother Mary. "I have long been in awe of fighters, and astounded by the discipline, intensity, and isolation the sport demands of them," Coel said to Variety. "I am excited to explore this world, especially so with A24 as my collaborators. Let's f***ing go." The original Bloodsport was inspired by Frank Dux's stories about competing in a secret underground tournament. None of Dux's claims--such as 329 straight victories, 56 consecutive knockouts, or organizers using high-speed cameras to track his lightning-fast kicks--have ever been proven, but the story still made for an entertaining film. The movie’s theme song, Fight to Survive, performed by Stan Bush, also helped boost its popularity at the box office. Continue Reading at GameSpot
